titleEnglish: My Daughter Left the Nest and Returned an S-Rank Adventurer
titleNative: 冒険者になりたいと都に出て行った娘がＳランクになってた
synonyms: My Daughter Grew Up to "Rank S" Adventurer.
My Daughter who Left for the Capital to Become an Adventurer Reached S Rank
想當冒險者前往都市的女兒成為S級: 黑髮的女武神
모험가가 되고 싶다며 도시로 떠났던 딸이 S랭크가 되었다
synopsis: Retired adventurer Belgrieve thought he was done with excitement...but his peaceful life is upended when he discovers a baby abandoned in the nearby woods. As her adoptive father, he teaches his new daughter Angeline everything he knows about the adventuring life—a past he had thought long forgotten after he lost his leg in battle. Angeline idolizes her father and wants to follow in his footsteps, so she leaves home for the big city. As the years pass, she ascends the ranks, eventually becoming renowned as an S-Rank adventurer: the Black-Haired Valkyrie. But it turns out that being the best comes with its own struggles, and she can barely catch her breath between battling fiends. With everyone turning to her for rescue, can Ange get out ahead of each new disaster and finally reunite with her beloved dad? (Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Tetsu Sabi to 1000 Carat
synopsis: This is a world where "Jewel-sama" are born with jewels in their eyes and special abilities. They live in a vast mansion called the "Jewel Box," and their duty is to grant people's wishes. The new arrival at the Jewel Box is Yuni, a girl with iron ore in her eyes, who is far from a beautiful jewel. Although she started her life as a "Master Jewel," she was not able to help people as much as she would like. Then she meets Alecrea, a master jeweler who is rumored to be a "Jewel Killer." He seems to be pursuing the unknown dark side of the jewelry box. In order to get closer to the truth, Yuni helps Alecrea and meets various other jewelry masters. Little does she know that she herself will eventually become the one to change the world. Follow your wishes and uncover the truth of the beautiful jewel box world. The unpredictable buddy and love fantasy between a girl with black iron and a rebellious young man begins! (Source: Pixiv Sylph, translated)

title: Ruri no Houseki
synopsis: Mineral collecting is like a modern-day treasure hunt! Ruri, a high school girl who loves jewelry and accessories, gets into the world of mineral collecting, venturing into mountains, rivers, and caves. The first volume features numerous minerals, including quartz, garnet, pyrite, gold sand, and fluorite. The manga is full of fascinating scenes focusing on specialized tools such as a panning dish, hammer, and topographical maps. An authentic scientific adventure based on the author's solid knowledge of mineralogy! (Source: Harta, translated)

synopsis: Meet Julio, a gay thirty-year-old man and best-selling author. Despite his success in publishing, however, Julio lives a life of solitude, keeping his true identity a secret while harboring feelings of inferiority regarding his sexuality and bland appearance. His world is soon turned upside-down, though, when he encounters a beautiful young man by the name of Angel. Standing up against the world's discriminations and prejudices, the two are soon captivated by each other... Dedicated to all who are seeking romance, this is a story of cinematic human love!! (Source: Renta!)

title: Wang You: Wo Neng Jinghua Yiqie
titleRomaji: Wang You: Wo Neng Jinghua Yiqie
synonyms: Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything
synopsis: Betrayed by his best friend, our protagonist loses everything: billions in wealth, his loved ones, and even his legs. In “Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything,” he gets a second chance at life. Reborn with a burning desire for vengeance, he vows to reclaim everything that was taken from him. When a revolutionary online game arrives, he finds himself at an advantage. No one understands this game better than he does! By getting into the game early and spending heavily, he can acquire a god-level skill known as "Evolve Everything." Now he prepares to exact his revenge. With his unmatched knowledge and newfound powers, he embarks on a journey to dominate the game and take back his rightful place in the world.
